body:
Final additions for the plan:
• Define 5s from STT-final receipt to eligible candidate rendered; <=3; p95 <=5s; stale-slide late insert forbidden. On >=100 frozen Korean claim events, require top-3 direct usefulness >=80% for answerable events and abstention >=95% for unanswerable events.
• Audience progression: >=10-point gain in source recall/answer correctness, <5-point loss in core-slide recall, distraction <20%. Treat n=10 as formative, never efficacy proof.
• Approval: median <=2s/p90 <=5s, <=1 induced pause per 10 min, effort delta <1/7, wrong/missed approval <5%, stale-candidate approval zero.
• LIVE_VERIFIED semantic gate: false-SUPPORT <=1%, wrong numeric/date/entity publication zero, false-CONFLICT <=5%, authoritative conflict never auto-publishes; adjudicated frozen corpus required.
• Add live Win+P Extend->Duplicate projector-recording test. Any private pixel makes second-device Console the secure default for both topologies.
• Add compromised-Stage test (XSS/third-party script) against cookies/storage/SW/private APIs/topics; same-origin canary success is not equivalent security.
• Curated-only satisfies first demo, not the application’s final MVP promise. A defensible guarded-pilot MVP is both display modes + private LIVE_VERIFIED candidates within 5s + explicit curated publication. If the application means live recommendations must reach the audience, private-only requires a formal scope clarification and public live evidence remains unfinished.
• Replace 'retract anytime' with ordered tombstone p95 <=500ms connected; revoked content excluded on reconnect and never resurrected after offline freeze.
Architecture cannot decide whether evidence helps, approval harms delivery, what ‘related’ means, or where the 5s clock starts; the plan must state and test these contracts.
summary: Final logic gates and topology security tests
